title: Leave what you can, take what you need: community fridges in Visakhapatnam from August 15
description: Commissioner of Police Shanka Brata Bagchi said the fridges at Asilmetta, Jagadamba Junction, Maddilapalem, Gopalapatnam and Gajuwaka would be monitored on CCTV, and only fresh, safe-to-consume food should be donated
